title: Some of them are wonky
text: Some of them are wonky. I already started filling the first bottles when I noticed that several have caps that don't fit properly. Well now it is too late to return, I wouldn't buy it again, but will use the ones that have no problem. The others I filled up and taped them shut, I just used those for the spices I use less. Bummer, there needs to be better quality control.
